stem.text: When an organic compound is oxidised, any oxygen atom gained by the organic molecule is considered to be from a water molecule also producing $2\text{H}^{+} + 2\text{e}^{-}$. Any hydrogen atom lost may be considered to be lost as $\text{H}^{+} + \text{e}^{-}$.
